asset.name: PageSchemaRenderer
asset.description: Renders a constrained declarative page schema through approved layouts, components, patterns, and templates, without permitting arbitrary markup to be smuggled through configuration.

requires.reason: Generated pages target the shared template family rather than composing raw primitives.

rationale: Constrained on purpose. A page schema that accepts arbitrary JSX has recreated the framework it was supposed to abstract, and loses every guarantee the catalog provides.
